risk_note: B1-03zl (D10-1181 ②): user-side order appeal, POST /v1/me/appeals target_type=order (BR-ID-36 ②). target_id = order_id read through a new risk port appealOrderReader (app.module, read-only, scoped to the app). Missing target_id → 20001; not a UUID / unknown / other app / not the caller's → 30701 (HTTP 404, stored by idempotency as a 3xxxx result, no existence leak); the caller's order not VOID+BLACKLIST → 20001 (fields target_id); a processing appeal on the order → the original; 3 appeals on the order (counted per order across all outcomes incl. revoked) → 30418; else insert. The account risk state is never touched (no appealing, no prev_risk_state, no event); deadline_at uses the account appeal's working-day calendar. Submissions on one order are serialized by pg_advisory_xact_lock(risk.appeals.order:app:order) after the target checks, plus the unique index appeals_processing_target_key with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. can_resubmit for an order appeal: latest on its order, upheld, order still VOID+BLACKLIST, attempts left. No audit_logs on submission, same as the account appeal (BR-ID-36 '写审计' is the console registration; orchestrator D10-1192 ③ / D10-1201). Frozen row [AC-B1-03i#19] removed earlier by test-change B1-03zm (#3065). Rule tests by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh); 4th test attempt one-off by D10-1192 (approvals 64); the [AC-B1-03zl#6] fix (same x-trace-id on first and replay requests, assertions unchanged) is a D10-844-style mechanical fix ruled by D10-1201, not counted as an attempt, and was moved before the implementation commits so the spec commit stays red. Implementation by Opus 5.5 in two rounds; container rule tests 40/40 green (red/6). No migration, no contract change. Out of scope (Codex money r2): admin-appeals-write.ts console registration of order appeals still resets the count after a revoked appeal and does not take the order lock — follow-up for the orchestrator. Written by hand.

reviews.note: Codex money: r1 fail (3 S1: order count reset after revoked; concurrent different-key submissions past 3; no audit_logs) → ① ② fixed, ③ ruled not applicable by D10-1192 ③ / D10-1201; r2 pass, two console-registration S1 recorded out of scope

spec_test_review.note: Codex spec-test r1 fail (3 S1) → r2 pass; r3 incremental (D10-1201) on the #6 x-trace-id header fix only: pass. Tests by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh)
